2.204.2
StateIndicator.ActionInfo
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The StateIndicator.ActionInfo element specifies the actions for a StateIndicator element. The
StateIndicator.ActionInfo element is optional.  This element is ignored in any schema version prior
to RDL 2010/01. This element is of type ActionInfo.
The following is the parent element of the StateIndicator.ActionInfo element.
Parent elements
StateIndicator
The following is the XML Schema definition of the StateIndicator.ActionInfo element.
 <xsd:element name="ActionInfo" type="ActionInfoType" minOccurs="0" />
